A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (6 January 2026). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-planetdefenderioncannon-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019): Same words as the disc card. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole of the disc card and the whole of the D-E1 card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
